formal_statement: ∀ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin 4 × Fin 6 → ℂ), (∀ t ∈ L, (∑ i : Fin 4, ∑ j, t (i, j)) = 0 ∧ (∑ j, ∑ l, if j = l then 0 else ∑ a : Fin 4, ∑ b : Fin 4, if a < b then t (a, j) * t (b, l) else 0) = 0 ∧ (∑ j, ∑ l, ∑ m, if j = l ∨ j = m ∨ l = m then 0 else ∑ a : Fin 4, ∑ b : Fin 4, ∑ c : Fin 4, if a < b ∧ b < c then t (a, j) * t (b, l) * t (c, m) else 0) = 0 ∧ (∑ j, ∑ l, ∑ m, ∑ n, if j = l ∨ j = m ∨ j = n ∨ l = m ∨ l = n ∨ m = n then 0 else t (0, j) * t (1, l) * t (2, m) * t (3, n)) = 0) → Module.finrank ℂ L ≤ 8
plain_statement: Let L be a linear space of 4 x 6 complex matrices such that, for every t in L, the entry sum and the sums of all 2 x 2, all 3 x 3 and all 4 x 4 subpermanents of t vanish. Then dim L <= 8. An open case of the level-space bound dim L <= p + q - 2 at four rows; the best spaces known have dimension 7 = p + q - 3.
title: Small case at four rows: a level space of 4 x 6 matrices has dimension at most 8 = p + q - 2
